# GQL queries: a GRAPH clause followed by linear query statements.
# Expected values are the documented results of the FinGraph examples, which TransferGraph holds
# without TIMESTAMP columns. A final NEXT aggregates each documented result table into one cell.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md

# The GRAPH clause example groups by a graph element, then joins it in the next statement. The
# documentation's table shows account 6 for Lee, who owns account 16.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (:Account)-[:Transfers]->(account:Account)
RETURN account, COUNT(*) AS num_incoming_transfers
GROUP BY account
NEXT
MATCH (account:Account)<-[:Owns]-(owner:Person)
RETURN account.id AS account_id, owner.name AS owner_name, num_incoming_transfers
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%s:%d', account_id, owner_name, num_incoming_transfers), ',' ORDER BY account_id) AS result
=> "7:Alex:1,16:Lee:3,20:Dana:1"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (:Account)-[:Transfers]->(account:Account)
RETURN account, COUNT(*) AS num_incoming_transfers
GROUP BY account
NEXT
MATCH (account:Account)<-[:Owns]-(owner:Person)
RETURN account.id AS account_id, owner.name AS owner_name, num_incoming_transfers
NEXT
FILTER num_incoming_transfers < 2
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%s', account_id, owner_name), ',' ORDER BY account_id) AS result
=> "7:Alex,20:Dana"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)-[o:Owns]->(a:Account)
FILTER p.Id <> 1
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s:%d', p.name, a.Id), ',' ORDER BY p.name) AS result
=> "Dana:20,Lee:16"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)-[o:Owns]->(a:Account)
FILTER WHERE p.Id <> 1
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s:%d', p.name, a.Id), ',' ORDER BY p.name) AS result
=> "Dana:20,Lee:16"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (source:Account)-[e:Transfers]->(dest:Account)
RETURN source, COUNT(e) AS num_transfers
GROUP BY source
NEXT
FILTER WHERE num_transfers > 1
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%d', source.id, num_transfers), ',' ORDER BY source.id) AS result
=> "7:2,20:2"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)-[o:Owns]->(a:Account)
FOR element in ["all","some"] WITH OFFSET
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%s:%d', p.Id, element, offset), ',' ORDER BY p.Id, element, offset) AS result
=> "1:all:0,1:some:1,2:all:0,2:some:1,3:all:0,3:some:1"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)-[o:Owns]->(a:Account)
FILTER WHERE p.Id <> 1
FOR element in GENERATE_ARRAY(1, p.Id)
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%d', p.Id, element), ',' ORDER BY p.Id, element) AS result
=> "2:1,2:2,3:1,3:2,3:3"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
FOR element in [] WITH OFFSET AS off
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "0"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
FOR element in CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<STRING>) WITH OFFSET
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "0"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
FOR element in [1,2,3]
WITH element as col
RETURN col
ORDER BY col
=> error contains: Expected keyword OFFSET but got identifier "element"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
FOR element in [1,2,3] WITH OFFSET
WITH element as col
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(col AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY col) AS result
=> "1,2,3"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (source:Account)-[e:Transfers]->(destination:Account)
LET a = source
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(a.id AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY a.id) AS result
=> "7,7,16,20,20"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (source:Account)-[e:Transfers]->(destination:Account)
LET a = source
RETURN a
NEXT
LET b = a
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(b.id AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY b.id) AS result
=> "7,7,16,20,20"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (source:Account)-[e:Transfers]->(destination:Account)
LET a = source
LET b = a
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(b.id AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY b.id) AS result
=> "7,7,16,20,20"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (source:Account)-[e:Transfers]->(destination:Account)
ORDER BY source.Id
LIMIT 3
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(source.Id AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY source.Id) AS result
=> "7,7,16"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (src_account:Account)-[transfer:Transfers]->(dst_account:Account {is_blocked:true})
RETURN src_account, COUNT(transfer) as total_transfers
ORDER BY total_transfers
LIMIT 1
NEXT
MATCH (src_account:Account)<-[owns:Owns]-(owner:Person)
RETURN FORMAT('%d:%s', src_account.id, owner.name) AS result
=> "20:Dana"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
# Without ORDER BY, only the number of rows left is determined.
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
OFFSET 2
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "1"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
SKIP 2
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "1"

# Ties at 300 are kept or skipped together.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (src_account:Account)-[transfer:Transfers]->(dst_account:Account)
ORDER BY transfer.amount DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%d', src_account.id, transfer.amount), ',' ORDER BY transfer.amount DESC, src_account.id) AS result
=> "20:500,7:300,16:300"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (src_account:Account)-[transfer:Transfers]->(dst_account:Account)
ORDER BY transfer.amount DESC
OFFSET 1
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%d', src_account.id, transfer.amount), ',' ORDER BY transfer.amount DESC, src_account.id) AS result
=> "7:300,16:300,20:200,7:100"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
LET a = 1, b = 2, c = 3
RETURN *
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s:%d', p.name, a + b + c), ',' ORDER BY p.name) AS result
=> "Alex:6,Dana:6,Lee:6"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (src:Account {id: 7})-[e:Transfers]->{1, 3}(dst:Account)
RETURN DISTINCT ARRAY_LENGTH(e) AS hops, dst.id AS destination_account_id
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%d', hops, destination_account_id), ',' ORDER BY hops, destination_account_id) AS result
=> "1:16,2:20,3:7,3:16"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (:Account)-[:Transfers]->(account:Account)
RETURN account, COUNT(*) AS num_incoming_transfers
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY num_incoming_transfers DESC
NEXT
MATCH (account:Account)<-[:Owns]-(owner:Person)
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s:%d', owner.name, num_incoming_transfers), ',' ORDER BY owner.name) AS result
=> "Alex:1,Dana:1,Lee:3"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name, p.id
OFFSET 1
NEXT
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "2"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name, p.id
OFFSET 1
LIMIT 1
NEXT
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "1"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name, p.id
LIMIT 1
OFFSET 1
=> error:

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (src:Account)-[transfer:Transfers]->(dst:Account)
WITH DISTINCT dst
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(dst.id AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY dst.id) AS result
=> "7,16,20"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (src:Account)-[transfer:Transfers]->(dst:Account)
WITH *, dst.id
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(dst.id AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY dst.id) AS result
=> "7,16,16,16,20"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (src:Account)-[transfer:Transfers]->(dst:Account)
WITH COUNT(*) AS transfer_total, src.id AS source_id, dst.id AS destination_id
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%d:%d:%d', transfer_total, destination_id, source_id), ',' ORDER BY source_id, destination_id) AS result
=> "2:16:7,1:20:16,1:7:20,1:16:20"

# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-query-statements.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name, 1 AS group_id
UNION ALL
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN 2 AS group_id, p.name
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s:%d', name, group_id), ',' ORDER BY group_id, name) AS result
=> "Alex:1,Dana:1,Lee:1,Alex:2,Dana:2,Lee:2"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name, 1 AS group_id
UNION ALL
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN 2 AS group_id, p.name
UNION ALL
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN 3 AS group_id, p.name
NEXT
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "9"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.name, 1 AS group_id
UNION ALL
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN 2 AS group_id, p.name
EXCEPT DISTINCT
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN 3 AS group_id, p.name
=> error:

# Other set operators follow their SQL semantics.
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.id
UNION DISTINCT
MATCH (p:Person)-[:Owns]->(:Account)
RETURN p.id
NEXT
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "3"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (a:Account)
RETURN a.id
INTERSECT DISTINCT
MATCH (:Account)-[:Transfers]->(a:Account {is_blocked: true})
RETURN a.id
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(id AS STRING)) AS result
=> "16"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (a:Account)
RETURN a.id
EXCEPT DISTINCT
MATCH (a:Account {is_blocked: true})
RETURN a.id
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(CAST(id AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY id) AS result
=> "7,20"

# Graph elements group by identity; NULL elements from OPTIONAL MATCH form one group.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/data-types.md
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (n:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:Owns]->(a:Account {is_blocked: TRUE})
RETURN a, COUNT(*) AS people
GROUP BY a
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%T:%d', a.id, people), ',' ORDER BY a.id) AS result
=> "NULL:2,16:1"
GRAPH scalar_graph.TransferGraph
MATCH (a:Account)-[e:Transfers]->(b:Account)
RETURN FORMAT('%d:%d', COUNT(DISTINCT a), COUNT(DISTINCT e)) AS result
=> "3:5"
GRAPH scalar_graph.AliasedNodes
MATCH (a:Author), (b:Reader)
WHERE a.id = b.id
RETURN a, b
NEXT
RETURN a, b, COUNT(*) AS n
GROUP BY a, b
NEXT
RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> "3"
